title: Creative Control Is Not Economic Control
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: Creative Control Is Not Economic Control: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: The power to approve a silhouette, campaign, or brand aesthetic is not automatically the power to appoint the board, control a vote, receive the economics, sell an asset, or survive termination.

frames.caption: 01 · CREATIVE — What can be approved?. Define the domain: collection, silhouette, casting, campaign, store environment, brand aesthetic, collaborator, or final release. “Creative control” without subject, threshold, and override mechanism is a slogan, not an operational record.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what can be approved? within Creative Control Is Not Economic Control.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · GOVERNANCE — Who directs the company?. For a Delaware corporation, start with the certificate, bylaws, board composition, delegated authority, and §141. Then inspect committees, reserved matters, stockholder rights, and actual agreements rather than assuming the creative title controls the enterprise.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who directs the company? within Creative Control Is Not Economic Control.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · ECONOMICS — Who receives value and bears risk?. Equity ownership, voting rights, salary, royalty, bonus, license income, liquidation preference, debt covenants, and sale proceeds are distinct economic or control mechanisms. Public proxy and annual-report disclosures can demonstrate some layers while leaving private arrangements unknown.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who receives value and bears risk? within Creative Control Is Not Economic Control.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · FAILURE TEST — What happens after conflict or departure?. Map removal, termination, good-reason provisions, cure periods, post-term use, transition duties, archive access, approval survival, and dispute procedure. Authority that exists only while a title is held may disappear differently from voting power or asset ownership.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what happens after conflict or departure? within Creative Control Is Not Economic Control.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Legal architecture cannot manufacture trust or artistic judgment. A founder with extensive formal rights can still fail to lead; a creative director with limited equity can still exercise enormous cultural power. The map is useful because it prevents cultural influence from being mistaken for enforceable authority—and prevents formal authority from being mistaken for artistic legitimacy.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for Creative Control Is Not Economic Control.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery
